annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously specifies that when the server can send a complete response before the client has sent the entire request, the server may send a RST_STREAM with error code NO_ERROR after sending the END_STREAM flag of the response. All terms are defined elsewhere in the specification, and the timing and error code are explicitly stated, leaving no materially different implementation interpretations.
